podcast.title: Cats in Windows - Photo Book
podcast.body: Max Knight is a photographer known for a photo book aptly titled *Cats in Windows*. "The photographer's name was Max Knight, a guy who coincidentally has a photo book called Cats in Windows, which is just like it sounds."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Sigh No More Album Cover Photographer
podcast.body: Max Knight was the photographer for Mumford & Sons' *Sigh No More* album cover, which was shot in the summer of 2009. The complex eight-hour shoot involved challenges such as a busy street, sun reflections, and disturbances from a nearby pub. "The photographer's name was Max Knight, a guy who coincidentally has a photo book called Cats in Windows, which is just like it sounds."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Debut Album Cover Photo (2009)
xref.body: The *Sigh No More* album cover, featuring all four band members in the window of Pimpernell & Partners (a 19th-century furniture shop at 596 The Kings Road, London), was shot by Max Knight in Summer 2009. The photograph took nearly eight hours to capture due to challenges such as a very hot day, the band arriving late, a busy street requiring clear shots (no cars, pedestrians, or cats), sun reflections ruining takes, and distractions from drunk Wimbledon watchers in a neighboring pub. "It's all four members of the band in the window of a shop at 596, The Kings Road, and the full area of London."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
